Name: Visible Weapons and Tools
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[center][size=5][font=Arial Black]Visible Weapons (Universal Framework 1.6)[/font][/size]
[font=Arial Black]A lightweight SMAPI mod that displays your currently equipped melee weapon crossed diagonally on your farmer's back when not in use.[/font]
[size=5][font=Arial Black]✨ Key Features[/font][/size]
[font=Arial Black]True Depth Layering: Weapons are drawn natively inside the farmer's assembly pipeline. Your shirt, hair, and arms will naturally cover the weapon when walking downwards or sideways—no floating sticker effects or weird sprite flickers.Perfect Diagonal Angle: Weapons rest with their hilts/handles pointing upwards over the shoulder for a classic sheath look.Universal Weapon Support: Works with vanilla weapons and any weapon injected through modding frameworks like Json Assets, SpaceCore, and Content Patcher.Tool Support: Axes, pickaxes, hoes, and fishing rods are also visible on your farmer, using the same offset system as weapons. Certain tools that don't look right sheathed (like watering cans) are intentionally excluded.Framework Friendly: Built to coexist with popular mods that change how the farmer looks or moves. Weapons hide automatically when they should, and adjust their draw depth when needed to avoid clipping with custom clothing layers.Auto-Hiding: The weapon safely hides itself when you use tools, eat, ride a horse, swim, sleep, or during cutscenes, to avoid clipping or floating sprites.Performance Friendly: Patches into the character's native drawing loop without file-reading timers or per-frame overhead. Sprites are cached on load.[/font]
[size=5][font=Arial Black]⚔️ Compatibility[/font][/size]
[font=Arial Black]Built from the ground up for [/font][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][font=Arial Black]. Designed to work alongside the most common modding frameworks and quality-of-life mods without conflicts. If you use a mod that changes the farmer's appearance, movement, or equipment display, chances are Visible Weapons already plays nicely with it.[/font]
[font=Arial Black]If you find an incompatibility, let me know and I'll look into it.[/font]
[size=5][font=Arial Black]⚠️ Bug Reports & Feedback[/font][/size]
[font=Arial Black]Since custom weapons can come in all shapes, sizes, and dimensions, some modded swords might need slight adjustments.[/font]
[font=Arial Black]If you find a weapon that doesn't display correctly, texturing glitches out, or doesn't show up at all, please let me know in the [/font][b][font=Arial Black]Bugs[/font][/b][font=Arial Black] or [/font][b][font=Arial Black]Posts[/font][/b][font=Arial Black] section! Provide the name of the weapon mod you are using so I can look into it and push a compatibility fix.[/font]
[size=5][font=Arial Black]🛠️ Installation[/font][/size]
[font=Arial Black]Install the latest version of [/font][url=https://smapi.io/][font=Arial Black]SMAPI[/font][/url][font=Arial Black].[/font]
[font=Arial Black]Download this mod and unzip it.[/font]
[font=Arial Black]Drop the VisibleWeapons folder into your  Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/font]
[font=Arial Black]Launch the game and enjoy![/font][/center]
[center][/center]
